sourceType.description:
If sourceType is an entity type then it's persisted instances will be used to collect the values. Another option
is an enum type in which case enum values will be used as possible values.

sourceField.description: Field name if #sourceType is an entity type.

distribution.description:
Represents distribution of #values i.e. number of occurrences of the specific value from #values (at 0 based index)
in the sample set. If distribution doesn't exist for an index of value will never generate that value. If there are
more distributions then values then generated value could be `null`.

title: Collection of possible values. See {@link Data.generate} & ${@link Data.profile}.
name: DataValues
